segments.ja308:1.1: Akaramhasa te kiccaṃ, yaṃ balaṃ ahuvamhase;
segments.ja308:1.3: Migarāja namo tyatthu, api kiñci labhāmase.
segments.ja308:2.3: Dantantaragato santo, taṃ bahuṃ yampi jīvasi.
segments.ja308:3.3: Yasmiṃ kataññutā natthi, niratthā tassa sevanā.
segments.ja308:4.3: Anusūya [anusuyya (sī. pī.)] manakkosaṃ, saṇikaṃ tamhā apakkameti.
